objective: Diagnosticar en solo lectura el paso pendiente del job comercial_range_batch ResyncLogID 535 para CIENFUEGOS 2026-10-13. Extraer únicamente campos de estado/diagnóstico del step: status, attempts, error_message, dry_run success/header/detail/warning/error y real success/header/detail/payments/warning/error. No modificar datos ni Producción.

queries.name: batch_step_diagnostic
queries.sql:
SELECT
        JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.steps."CIENFUEGOS|2026-10-13|2026-10-13".status') AS step_status,
        JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.steps."CIENFUEGOS|2026-10-13|2026-10-13".attempts') AS attempts,
        JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.steps."CIENFUEGOS|2026-10-13|2026-10-13".error_message') AS step_error,
        JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.steps."CIENFUEGOS|2026-10-13|2026-10-13".dry_run.success') AS dry_success,
        JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.steps."CIENFUEGOS|2026-10-13|2026-10-13".dry_run.header_success') AS dry_header_success,
        JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.steps."CIENFUEGOS|2026-10-13|2026-10-13".dry_run.detail_success') AS dry_detail_success,
        JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.steps."CIENFUEGOS|2026-10-13|2026-10-13".dry_run.warning_message') AS dry_warning,
        JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.steps."CIENFUEGOS|2026-10-13|2026-10-13".dry_run.error_message') AS dry_error,
        JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.steps."CIENFUEGOS|2026-10-13|2026-10-13".real.success') AS real_success,
        JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.steps."CIENFUEGOS|2026-10-13|2026-10-13".real.header_success') AS real_header_success,
        JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.steps."CIENFUEGOS|2026-10-13|2026-10-13".real.detail_success') AS real_detail_success,
        JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.steps."CIENFUEGOS|2026-10-13|2026-10-13".real.payments_success') AS real_payments_success,
        JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.steps."CIENFUEGOS|2026-10-13|2026-10-13".real.warning_message') AS real_warning,
        JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.steps."CIENFUEGOS|2026-10-13|2026-10-13".real.error_message') AS real_error
      FROM dbo.Sistema_Sync_ResyncLog
      WHERE ResyncLogID=535 AND TipoSync='comercial_range_batch'
